svg.aria-label: Six vibration motors sit around the head: front, back, left, right and one at each temple. The page turns each game event into a pattern, a function of time, and streams six motor levels to an Arduino about thirty times a second. The board copies them to its pins and switches everything off after 400 milliseconds of silence.
svg.title: The headgear: from a hit on screen to a buzz on the head
